description: Baseline: speculation adds ~88ms overhead (393ms vs 305ms). Shadow construction 70ms, drain 10ms, claim wait 276ms. Only 29ms of tool latency hidden. The speculation engine is currently a net LOSS.

asi.bottleneck: claim_wait dominates at 276ms - the real execution waits for speculations that haven't finished yet
asi.key_insight: speculation is currently a net LOSS - adds 88ms overhead instead of saving time
next_ideas: thread-based shadow to eliminate subprocess spawn overhead
batch pipe messages to reduce per-segment overhead
improve claim hit rate or reduce claim wait time

description: Use fork instead of spawn for shadow subprocess. Shadow construction dropped from70ms to 2.5ms (28x faster). Drain barrier dropped from 10ms to 1.5ms. Total speculated time improved slightly (393ms to 388ms) but claim wait still dominates at 271ms.

next_ideas: reduce claim wait by improving speculation timing
batch multiple tool calls to increase parallelism

description: Fix segmenter to track string state across lines (handle newlines inside strings like "\n\n"). The segmenter now correctly emits assignments before loops, enabling the peek engine to find6 plans instead of0. Tests pass.

asi.improvement: segmenter now handles newlines in strings correctly, enabling loop unrolling for common patterns like context.split('\n\n')
next_ideas: test with more realistic workload where shadow dispatches multiple calls
optimize claim wait budget for better tradeoff
start speculation earlier in the pipeline
